name: Centro Valle Intelvi (Italy)
description: White field with a blue border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Centro Valle Intelvi (stars and a red castle on blue) within branches and the inscription COMUNE DI CENTRO VALLE INTELVI in grey above.
history: The flag was granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 8 July 2021.

features.role: Centro Valle Intelvi arms — stars and a red castle on blue, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI CENTRO VALLE INTELVI above the arms
